meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Run a dependency graph of child agents in one call with the native dag tool. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行多个依赖子任务,一次调用完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要同时运行多个子任务,且任务间有先后依赖。
copy.tagline_en: Execute multiple dependent subtasks in one call.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run multiple subtasks with dependencies in a single orchestrated call.

howto.what: 使用该技能后,Claude 会把一项大任务拆成多个有先后依赖的小任务,画成依赖图一次性执行:先完成前置任务,再并行推进后续任务,最后按既定标准核对结果才算完成。整个过程按固定流程规划、执行、监督,并支持单独重试或修改某个小任务。
howto.when: 当用户提到 “mass-ulw”、要求做“任务 DAG”或“扇出/扇入”工作,或要求多代理执行且部分任务必须等待其他任务完成时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这个任务拆成依赖图:先审计代码,再重写,最后验证。
say.note: Claude 会先读规划文档,再定义节点并按依赖顺序执行。

say.text: 把这两个步骤做成 DAG,让第二步等第一步完成后再跑。
say.note: 生成依赖图,第二步会在第一步完成后自动启动。

say.text: 对刚才那个 DAG 里失败的节点重试一下,跳过 vendor 目录。
say.note: 只重试指定节点,已完成节点保留结果。

howto.what_en: Claude runs child agents as a dependency graph in one call: prerequisites finish first, then dependents run in parallel, results verified before completion. Plans first, supervises mid-run, can retry/send/amend single nodes.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, fan-out/fan-in work, or any multi-agent job where some tasks depend on others (must wait).

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to split this into a DAG: audit the code, rewrite, then verify.
say_en.note: Claude plans first, then defines and runs nodes in order.

say_en.text: Make these two steps a DAG so the second waits for the first.
say_en.note: The second step auto-starts after the first completes.

say_en.text: Retry the failed node in that DAG, skipping the vendor dir.
say_en.note: Only that node retries; finished nodes keep cached results.
